findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 10 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 83 questions numbered 1-83; by section: 10.1 4, 10.2 8, 10.3 3, 10.4 2, 10.5 4, 10.6 3, 10.7 3, 10.8 5, 10.9 3, 10.10 4, 10.11 4, 10.12 3, 10.13 1, 10.14 3, 10.15 5, 10.16 2, 10.17 7, 10.18 2, 10.19 4, 10.20 3, 10.21 2, 10.22 3, 10.27 5.

Covers sections 10.1-10.22 and 10.27 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's sample problems and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻, 2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂, twice on the left-hand side, Cl₂(g) at the anode, 99646 C per mole of electrons, E°cell = E°(cathode) − E°(anode), Ag⁺/Ag = +0.80 V, Mg²⁺/Mg = −2.37 V, acidified KMnO₄ = +1.51 V, Zn sample answer −0.79 V).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
